changes: Photo Fusion was rewritten: standard layout, thirteen new scenes, new prompts shown before sending, and no debug mode. Code inherited from earlier starting points was replaced, including the image upload box, the progress card, several icons and the first thirteen character poses. Version 2.0 reworked every settings panel into one layout with standard lists, sliders and prompt boxes, made lists and menus reliable after a generation, kept running jobs when switching tabs, made Studio Light readable everywhere and removed the FLUX 1, Nunchaku, FLUX Krea and WAN 2.2 workflows.
